words.definition: overly confident or aggressive; careless about consequences
words.example: The brash young man made many poor business decisions.
words.zh: 過於自信或咄咄逼人；不顧後果

words.definition: to make more easily understood; to make clear
words.example: Chapter 2 in the textbook clarifies the process of osmosis.

words.definition: to prevent from being seen or discovered
words.example: The students concealed their feelings about the course.
The director confirmed that the meeting would be on the tenth.

words.definition: easy to reach; near; suitable to one's needs
words.example: The investigator suspected that the disappearance of the evidence was too convenient to be accidental.
words.zh: 容易到達；靠近;適合某人的需要

words.definition: the central or most important part of something
words.example: The core curriculum consists of courses that are required of all students.
words.zh: 某事物的中心或最重要的部分

words.definition: very serious or unsafe; finding fault
words.example: It is critical to follow the directions for the experiment exactly as the instructor indicates.
words.zh: 非常嚴重或不安全；找茬

words.definition: a difference between things that should be similar or equal
words.example: The discrepancy in her experiment data led her to believe that she had made a mistake.
words.zh: 應該相似或相等的事物之間的差異

words.definition: to change from the original shape or condition, usually in an unnatural way
words.example: Time and space are distorted when traveling at the speed of light.
words.zh: 通常以不自然的方式改變原來的形狀或狀況

words.example: Freud had many diverse interests in psychology.
words.zh: 各種各樣的;與其他人不同

words.definition: to happen at some time in the future, usually gradually
words.example: A good education will eventually pay big dividends.
words.zh: 在未來的某個時間點發生，通常是逐漸發生

words.example: In the early 1900s, San Francisco was a prosperous city.
The architect purposefully placed large windows on the south wall to capture more sunlight.
The president revealed some of his ideas before he gave his speech.
The woman scarcely spoke a word of English.

words.definition: according to a reasoned, but not proven, point of view
words.example: His argument was theoretically appealing, but not realistic.
words.zh: 根據合理但未經證實的觀點
